decisions.reason: The manual laser workstation is less aligned with the firm's integrated production-line knowledge and Industry 4.0 trajectory, giving lower absorptive capacity to improve it, but we keep it while monitoring early results.
High-resolution thermal inkjet builds directly on the firm's existing inkjet and coding knowledge, allowing it to interpret early results and improve the product, so drop probability is low.

High-resolution piezo inkjet similarly leverages the firm's inkjet expertise and fits its digitalized traceability direction, so the firm can assimilate and improve it, resulting in low drop probability.
